OUR LITTLE STORY

Small ideas. Big imagination.

UraXx was created for makers, dreamers, artists and curious minds. From shimmering pebbles to wax, acrylic and everyday craft essentials, we bring creative materials together so your next idea can take shape.

We believe creativity belongs to everyone — whether you are trying your first DIY project, preparing a classroom activity or building something for your studio.

Creativity takes flight! — Team UraXx

A FEW QUICK ANSWERS

Before you start creating.

Which payment method is available?

UraXx currently accepts Cash on Delivery (COD). Online payment is not available on this website.

How do I place an order?

Add your chosen products and pack sizes to the cart, continue to checkout, and enter your delivery details. The checkout displays Cash on Delivery as the payment method.

Need help choosing a product?

Contact the UraXx team on WhatsApp and share what you are planning to make.
